meta.tldr: Aider 0.86.0 significantly expands its AI model compatibility, now fully supporting all GPT-5 models and integrating Grok-4 via `xai/grok-4` and `openrouter/x-ai/grok-4`. This broadens the range of powerful AI backends developers can leverage for code generation and assistance. The release also adds support for `gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview-06-17` and `openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2`, further diversifying available models. Command-line usability has been improved: `/clear` now provides confirmation with "All chat history cleared.", and `/undo` output is more concise, showing only the first line of commit messages for better readability. A key fix addresses an issue where new settings for existing models failed to overwrite old ones, ensuring model configurations are correctly applied. Analytics have been updated to support the latest PostHog SDK, and underlying dependencies, including `litellm==1.75.0`, have been bumped for stability and new features. Developers should upgrade to take advantage of the expanded model support and improved command feedback.
